basic_details.job_title: JNCASR Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One temporary Research Associate position is open in the ANRF sponsored project "Light-Triggered Synthetic Host-Guest Recognition for Multicolor Single-Molecule Super Resolution Imaging" under Prof. Sarit S. Agasti, New Chemistry Unit, Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR), Bengaluru. The remuneration is Rs. 46,800 plus applicable HRA for Research Associate (Provisional) or Rs. 58,000 plus applicable HRA for Research Associate. A PhD in Chemistry, Biology or related areas is essential. Applications go by email to [email protected] latest by 17 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted by email only, as described in the notice.
Get the Application form in Template, which the notice says is available on the website.
Fill in the application form duly.
Attach copies of original testimonials in support of educational qualification, age, experience, publication, etc.
Email the application to [email protected] latest by 17 November 2026.
Duly filled Application form in Template
Copies of original testimonials for educational qualification, age, experience, publication, etc.
No Objection Certificate from the employer, for outside candidates who are in employment
important_instructions: Those in employment must submit a 'No Objection Certificate' from the employer; this applies only to outside candidates. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the online interview.

rows.details: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR)
Light-Triggered Synthetic Host-Guest Recognition for Multicolor Single-Molecule Super Resolution Imaging
Temporary position sanctioned in the project
Rs. 46,800 plus applicable HRA (Provisional) / Rs. 58,000 plus applicable HRA
New Chemistry Unit, JNCASR, Jakkur, Bengaluru

content_sections.heading: About JNCASR
content_sections.text: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research, Jakkur P.O., Bengaluru - 560064, Karnataka, is described on its letterhead as an autonomous institution under the Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and an Institution Deemed-to-be-University. This vacancy sits in its New Chemistry Unit, in a project led by Principal Investigator Prof. Sarit S. Agasti.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: PhD in Chemistry, Biology or related areas. Thesis submitted: Candidates who have submitted thesis but have not completed the defence can also apply. Desirable qualification: Experience in immunology, Cell Culture. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for age and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNCASR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted by email only, as described in the notice. Get the Application form in Template, which the notice says is available on the website. Fill in the application form duly. Attach copies of original testimonials in support of educational qualification, age, experience, publication, etc. Attach a brief resume. Email the application to [email protected] latest by 17 November 2026. Duly filled Application form in Template Copies of original testimonials for educational qualification, age, experience, publication, etc. Brief resume No Objection Certificate from the employer, for outside candidates who are in employment

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview. Candidates will be selected based on their performance in the interview by a selection committee. The notice does not give the interview date.

content_sections.text: Those in employment must submit a 'No Objection Certificate' from the employer; this applies only to outside candidates. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the online interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in JNCASR Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. NCU-EMR-183)?
faq.answer: There is 1 temporary Research Associate position in the ANRF sponsored project in the New Chemistry Unit.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed to [email protected] latest by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: A PhD in Chemistry, Biology or related areas is essential. Experience in immunology, Cell Culture is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates who have only submitted their PhD thesis apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who have submitted thesis but have not completed the defence can also apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the JNCASR Research Associate?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 46,800 plus applicable HRA for Research Associate (Provisional) and Rs. 58,000 plus applicable HRA for Research Associate.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes. Both remuneration levels are paid plus applicable HRA, as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for JNCASR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the duly filled Application form in Template with copies of testimonials and a brief resume to [email protected] by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview, and selection will be based on performance in the interview by a selection committee.

faq.question: Q10. Do employed candidates need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. Those in employment must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer; this applies only to outside candidates.
